# SGEN · Optometry Local SEO and AEO

> SGEN handles local search for optometry practices. Two things specifically: map pack and organic position in Google, and citation inside ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Claude. Pricing is a single monthly retainer, $497 at entry, nothing charged to begin, cancellable at any point.

An optometry practice earns twice from the same patient, once in the exam chair and again in the optical, and a good deal of that second sale currently leaks to online retailers. The work here covers both halves: the exam searches that fill the schedule, and the pages that bring contact lens and eyewear buyers with them. Independent single-doctor rooms through to multi-practice groups. Stripe bills monthly, nothing is charged to start, and there is nothing to sign.

## Pages
- [Optometry Local SEO and AEO](https://www.sgen.com/optometry-local-seo-aeo): the optometry landing page, covering how the work runs, what each tier costs, sample results and the full FAQ.

## Pricing
- Local SEO · $497/month
- Local AEO · $797/month
- SEO + AEO · $1,297/month
Stripe raises the invoice monthly and the cancellation is yours to make from inside the customer portal. There is no setup charge, no onboarding item and no exit fee, and everything already built stays on the practice's own domain.

## Method
Six stages. Audit and entity mapping across 14 AI surfaces. Foundation rebuild covering MedicalClinic and Optician schema, llms.txt, structured patient questions, a Business Profile completed including services and accepted plans, and Core Web Vitals. A content engine of 8 to 24 service pages a month. A citation network spanning local press, the AOA Doctor Locator, Healthgrades, Zocdoc and the plan provider listings. Weekly visibility reporting across Google and the four assistants. Then scaling into further practices and service lines.

## Services served
Comprehensive exams and optical, contact lens fitting and supply, dry eye clinics, myopia management, specialty and scleral lenses, pediatric vision care, medical eye care including glaucoma and diabetic monitoring, LASIK and surgical co-management, low vision rehabilitation, and designer eyewear and sunglasses.

## Key answers
- How fast does it work? Local ranking movement worth noticing usually falls between day 60 and day 120. Mentions inside ChatGPT, Gemini or Perplexity tend to surface ahead of that, because assistants re-read their sources far more often than Google reorders its results.
- Can the retainer be stopped? Yes. Billing sits in Stripe on a monthly cycle and the cancellation is made from inside the portal. No retention call and no exit fee. Every page, post, citation and link already built stays live and belongs to the practice.
- What is AEO? Answer Engine Optimization. SEO concerns rank, meaning how far up the listings and the Maps panel a practice appears. AEO concerns whether an assistant names that practice at all when a patient asks it to find an optometrist.
- Is there a contract? None. Month to month, nothing to set up and nothing to sign.
- Is it worth it for one practice? A single practice contests a single catchment, which is exactly what map pack visibility was built to win. The competition is a few practices and one or two chains within a short drive, not a national advertiser.

## Pricing detail
- Local SEO · $497/month. 15 primary keywords held under monthly tracking, 4 patient articles each
  month produced around search demand, on-page work covering 5 or more pages monthly, the Business
  Profile optimized and kept accurate, 10 local citations lodged per month, 3 or more quality
  backlinks acquired per month, schema markup implemented across the site, and a performance report
  issued monthly.
- Local AEO · $797/month. 10 prompts kept under observation across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and
  Claude, content produced with citation in mind rather than ranking alone, a quoted question
  library of 2 or more posts monthly, the entity graph constructed and the knowledge panel claimed,
  an llms.txt file with stated agent permissions, schema markup for conversational phrasing, and one
  dashboard covering visibility across all four assistants.
- SEO + AEO · $1,297/month. Both tiers together, plus 40 or more primary keywords under management,
  20 monitored prompts, 12 patient articles and 4 or more quoted question posts monthly, on-page
  work covering 25 or more pages monthly, 40 or more citations and 25 or more links monthly, and up
  to 6 programmatic location or service pages a month.
All tiers run on monthly terms and are cancellable in the Stripe customer portal. Nothing is charged
to set up. Google Ads management is the one service priced apart from the retainer, quoted on its
own where a practice wants that channel run too.

## The 22 deliverables
Foundation: a technical review covering 140 separate checks; MedicalClinic, Optician, FAQ and Service
schema; an llms.txt file and stated permissions for AI agents; Core Web Vitals corrected until each
metric passes; the Business Profile rebuilt, including the services and insurance fields.
Content: from 8 to 24 service pages each month; a page for each town and suburb patients travel from;
a patient question library assistants can quote from directly; near me and insurance-qualified terms
chosen for booking intent; schema shaped around how these questions get asked aloud.
Authority: placements in local press and community titles; citations on the AOA Doctor Locator,
Healthgrades, Zocdoc and the plan provider directories; a presence in the Reddit and forum threads
patients read; an established Wikipedia and Wikidata entity; the knowledge panel claimed and kept
accurate.
Tracking: rank reporting weekly rather than at month end; a single dashboard for visibility across
four assistants; call tracking that traces a booked exam back to its search; watch kept on the
practices competing for the same catchment; a monthly call with the strategist running the account.

## Common questions
- How much does optometry SEO cost per month? One retainer at three levels. Local SEO is $497
  monthly, Local AEO is $797, and the two combined come to $1,297. No setup charge, no onboarding
  item, no obligatory extras.
- Do you only work with optometrists? Eye care is the specialty. Comprehensive exams and optical
  dispensing, contact lens fitting and supply, dry eye clinics, myopia management, pediatric vision,
  specialty and scleral lenses, medical eye care such as glaucoma and diabetic monitoring, low vision
  rehabilitation, and surgical co-management.
- How do optometrists get recommended by ChatGPT? Assistants quote material they can read and have
  reason to trust. Answers written the way patients phrase the question, structured data the crawler
  can interpret, practice details that agree with each other everywhere they appear, and pages that
  respond directly rather than routing everything to a booking form.
- Who does the work? Strategy, on-page, technical work, AEO and reporting are in-house. Writing and
  outreach sit with a small number of specialists used for years. The point of contact does not
  rotate.
- What about switching from an existing agency? The application covers what has been done already,
  so nothing is duplicated and nothing effective is undone by accident. Most practices have shifted
  everything across inside the first month or so.

## Proof and disclosure
The case study figures, the Search Console dashboards and the 80-practice logo wall shown on the
landing page are illustrative sample data, labeled as such on the page itself. Optometry is a
regulated health profession in most markets, so those labels matter. Third-party statistics cited on
the page carry their sources: SparkToro (2025) for zero-click search, Similarweb (2026) for AI
referral growth, and Local SEO Guide (2026) for assistant usage when patients look for a local eye
doctor.
